Here are the National and YCS Champions hoping to be crowned Central American Champion this weekend. Taking part in the Main Event are Gabriel Durán Barahona from Costa Rica, Victor Alonso Mejia Moreno from the Dominican Republic, Marvin Josue Enamorado Maldonado from Honduras, Guadalajara, Mexico’s very own Erick Laurentino Ramirez Rodriguez, Alejandro Vivaldo Reyes Suarez from Mexico (YCS Champion), Latchman Sookdeo Maraj from Trinidad & Tobago, Bruno Eduardo Montuori Fernandez from Guatemala and Jose Arthuro Cross Lay from Panama.

And in the Dragon Duel World Championship Qualifier, we have Marco Jossue Ruiz Campos from Costa Rica, who is here to try and repeat last year’s performance and make it to the World Championship, Ivan Enrique de Jesus Alvarez Castro from the Dominican Republic, Luis Felipe Vasquez Rodriguez from Honduras, Alejandro Uriel Martinez Garcia from Mexico, Hugo Fernando Escobar Sanchez from Guatemala, and Francisco Ernesto Palacios Castillo from Panama.
Good luck to these Champions, and to the rest of the Duelists! It’s time to Duel!
Central America’s best Duelists have gathered here in Guadalajara, Mexico to compete in one of the most competitive Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME tournaments of the year!

Lots of Duelists earned invitations to this prestigious event through Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series tournaments, Regional Qualifiers, Dragon Duels, and National Championships. Soon, the best of the best will battle it out for the grand prize: a chance to represent their country and their continent at the Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME World Championship 2014!

One Duelist from the Central American World Championship Qualifier and one young Duelist from the Central American Dragon Duel World Championship Qualifier will be declared the ultimate winners of the weekend. Only those two Duelists will earn the honor of competing in this year’s two World Championships hosted in Italy, and will have their travel and accommodations paid for by Konami. Several other prizes will also be awarded this weekend, but all eyes are on the top prize.

Although the World Championship Qualifier and Dragon Duel World Championship Qualifier have not yet begun, Duelists have gathered in anticipation of the weekend ahead of them. It’s almost time to Duel!

I surveyed some of the Duelists in attendance to find out which Deck they think will take the top prize this weekend. Check out their responses!
